draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.90, the 195th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 14th of 18 at S. He went 130th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (195th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 70 tackles in 2024, 10th of 18 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 17 career games and 14 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: combined tackles 101 (87th percentile). Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 safety who played: 84.2% season snap share against a median of 24.1%, above the norm.
